rationale: Colin brings 20 years of infrastructure and developer relations expertise, currently bridging GPU cloud infrastructure with builders at Nebius, while Olasile is actively shipping AI agent and automation products at AWS—creating a natural exchange where Colin's conviction on purpose-built inference infrastructure and ecosystem-building strategy directly complements Olasile's product work on agentic systems. Both are based in San Francisco, share focus on developer tools and AI agents, and Colin's mentorship background in devrel strategy and his hands-on experience with multi-agent systems (CrewAI, agentic AI tooling) could inform how Olasile thinks about product positioning and developer adoption.
intro_message: Colin Nebius, meet Olasile Abolade — Colin's deep experience building community and infrastructure for AI agents at Nebius and Dabl.Club pairs well with Olasile's product work on AI agents and automation at AWS, especially around how purpose-built infrastructure enables real product adoption.
